names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 30 Οκτωβρίου, «Αγία Ευτροπία», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on her name link behind her line for 30 октября ст. ст., «Евтропия Александрийская, мц.», with the rank word left off. The line itself declines the name, «Евтропии Александрийской».

feast.note: The Greek calendar keeps her on its own 30 October; this is the Russian calendar's own day and not a second day on one calendar. Her life page is headed «День памяти: 30 октября» and lists no other.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 октября ст. ст. — «Мц. Евтропии Александрийской (ок. 250).»
source.note: The line is the fourth of the day. The day carries one typikon sign only, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком», so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: The Russian agrees with the Greek day and the city, and gives her the first narrative and the first date this folder has had: she visited the Christians shut up in the prisons often, and called them to bear their sufferings patiently; for that the persecutors of the Christians took her for torture; at the trial she confessed her faith in Christ firmly, and she died of the cruelty of the torments. The city is Alexandria in both calendars.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ης Οκτωβρίου — «Αγία Ευτροπία»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **This is an open identity question and the report says so.** The corpus already keeps a folder «eutropia-25-june», display name Eutropia, with a Greek feast on 25 June and the rank Όσιομάρτυς, and no city and no life. This entry is a different day, a different rank — plain Άγια and a martyr by beheading — and a life with a city and a persecutor in it: Alexandria in Egypt and the prefect Appellianos. On the corpus's settled rule that two entries on one calendar are two commemorations, and on those three differences, this is drafted as a second woman; a writer who reads the 25 June page and finds otherwise should make this an upgrade of that folder instead. The page gives no year, so no `dates` object. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (1 October 2026).

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 30 октября ст. ст. prints «(ок. 250)» and its life for her repeats it, «пострадала за Христа в Александрии около 250 года» — about 250, written «ок.» and «около» in both places. The folder held no `dates` before this; saint.gr gave her no year.
